newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian minority party opens election webpage.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian minority party opens election webpage.

text.p: Indonesia's minority United Development Party (PPP) on Monday opened its own Internet page ahead of next month's general elections in an attempt to make direct contact with potential voters.

"Not all the ideas of our party are covered by the mass media, so we are trying to use the Internet as the medium to broadcast the positions of our party," PPP secretary-general Tosari Wijaya told Reuters.
"It's more direct and open to whoever wants to access it," Wijaya said.
The Indonesian language PPP Online at http://202.152.0.224 claimed to have almost 14,000 visitors in its few hours of operation.
"We plan to update it every day and include the campaign programme and campaign speeches," Wijaya said.
Both the Moslem-oriented PPP and Christian-Nationalist Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) have often complained the ruling Golkar party monopolises access to state-run broadcast media.
Supporters running the homepage of ousted PDI leader Megawati Sukarnoputri, Red and White Online, (http://www.merahputih.com), confirmed at the weekend the site had been withdrawn.
They declined to elaborate on the reason.
